description: Synthetic vulnerability finding 00001 for offline testing.
recommendation: Review and remediate finding 00001 using applicable vendor guidance.
plugin_output: Simulated scan evidence for unique finding 00001.

source_record.Description: The target system supports weak SSL/TLS cipher suites that may allow an attacker to weaken encrypted communication.
source_record.Recommendation: Disable weak cipher suites and allow only strong TLS configurations.
source_record.POC/Plugin Output: The server supports TLS_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA on port 443.
source_record.Evidence: Nessus scan output confirms weak cipher suite support.
source_record.Comments: Remediation activity assigned to infrastructure team.
source_record.Impact: An attacker may exploit weak cryptographic configurations to reduce the security of encrypted communication.
source_record.Solution: Disable 3DES and other weak cipher suites. Configure the server to support TLS 1.2 or higher with strong cipher suites.
